messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, dia dah cakap nak ikut. Kita tunggu dia kat sini je.

messages.en: Yes, he said he's coming. Let's just wait for him here.

etymology.historical_story: Davian is attested as a personal name, but this packet supplies no documented naming history. A user-submitted name reference links it to Davion; that is insufficient to establish a definitive origin or inherited meaning. In Malay text, the responsible interpretation is therefore an unchanged personal name, with pronunciation established by its bearer. See the [submitted-name record](https://www.behindthename.com/name/davian/submitted).
